learning.learning_goal: Count and make groups of one, two, and three again in a new session.
learning.big_idea: The number of dots stays the same when the dots move.
assumed_prior_knowledge: counting one, two, and three in the first lesson
novice_success_criteria: count new groups without a model on the screen
make two and three dots without seeing the answer first
choose the numeral for a spoken number

screens.label: Come back later
screens.title: Count again.
screens.body: Try new groups of 1, 2, and 3. Come back on another day, too.
screens.audio: Let's count again. Try these new dots. You can come back another day, too.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Look at these dots. Count them. How many?

visual.ariaLabel: Two dots in different places, with no numbers shown.

choices.feedback: Touch each dot once. You can stop after the second dot.
There is another dot. Touch both.

hints: Touch a dot, then the other dot.
One, two. There are two dots.

screens.title: Make 3 dots.
screens.audio: Make three dots. Tap Add a dot until there are three. Then check.
screens.wrongFeedback: Count the dots you made. Try again.
screens.tooManyFeedback: There are more than three. Remove a dot, then count again.
screens.tooFewFeedback: There are fewer than three. Add a dot, then count again.
hints: Tap Add a dot. Count each new dot.
One, two, three. Stop at three.

screens.title: How many dots?
screens.audio: Look at the new group. How many dots?

visual.ariaLabel: One dot in a new place, with no number shown.

choices.feedback: Touch the dot you see. There is only one.
Look again. There is only one dot.

screens.title: Make 2 dots.
screens.audio: Make two dots. Count as you add them. Then check.
screens.wrongFeedback: Count the dots you made. Try again.
screens.tooManyFeedback: There are more than two. Remove a dot, then count again.
screens.tooFewFeedback: There are fewer than two. Add a dot, then count again.
hints: Tap Add a dot and count it. Add another dot.

screens.title: Which number is three?
screens.audio: Listen: three. Which number is three? Tap it.

choices.feedback: One is the number for one dot. Listen to three again.
Two is the number for two dots. Listen to three again.

screens.title: You counted again.
screens.body: Come back another day and try new dots again.
screens.audio: You counted again. Come back another day and try again.
